focusedModelSuite.dependencyEnvironment: The isolated review worktree used a temporary, removed symlink to the exact implementation worktree's existing node_modules. No install ran and no package or lockfile changed.

remainingP1s: transition coverage remains vacuous for three domains
PushKit must-report liveness and terminal native-action cleanup remain vacuous

phase1Ci.resumptionAction: The coordinator owns the single frozen-head Phase 1 CI run. Do not merge while the open P1 findings remain.

findings.evidence: The three committed positive witnesses cover only chat-call, livekit, and notification-native-action. RevenueCat, OTA/build, and migrations have zero witnesses. Replacing apply with an identity transition for each of those three domains still returned MODEL_CLEAR for 20/20 property cases with witnessCount=0.
findings.impact: Three mandatory T2 domains can ignore every generated command and still pass. Property-case totals therefore remain a false readiness signal for provider ordering, build/update compatibility, and migration reconciliation transitions.
findings.requiredResolution: Define required state/transition coverage and positive witnesses for every modeled domain, fail when any required witness is absent or not reached, and add a regression proving an identity/no-op apply function is BLOCKED_INTERNAL in all six domains.

findings.evidence: A must-report receive_push can remain unreported and uncompleted indefinitely with no violation. The added historical fixture only detects a variant that records completion without report; the fixed transition silently refuses completion and has no terminal obligation check or must-report witness. Separately, native Answer can remain pending across server_timeout and be consumed after the server is terminal, also with no violation.
findings.impact: MODEL_CLEAR still does not prove the required PushKit must-report obligation or exact decline/cancel/timeout cleanup, and it permits lifecycle-stale native actions after terminal server state.
findings.requiredResolution: Model an explicit must-report obligation with a bounded or terminal evaluation point and a positive receive-report-complete witness. Make terminal server transitions clear or irrevocably deny pending actions, reject post-terminal consumption, enforce exactly-once terminal cleanup, and add Answer/Decline/Cancel/Timeout/Busy regressions.

findings.evidence: The authoritative comparison rejects only strictly older events. With provider renewal and transfer at the same event time, renewal-then-transfer ends with target ownership while transfer-then-renewal ends with source ownership; both report zero violations. The declared concurrency scenario assigns times 10 and 20, so timestamp precedence—not an exact tie policy—makes its two schedules converge.
findings.impact: The same authoritative provider event multiset can yield different entitlement owners solely from delivery order. That defeats deterministic out-of-order reconciliation for a Level C money/provider model.
findings.requiredResolution: Define and model a total authoritative ordering or an explicit fail-closed ambiguity state for equal timestamps, include event identity/type precedence in the contract, and add equal-time renewal/transfer and expiration/renewal schedules that must converge or block.

findings.evidence: Running the concurrency suite with --domain=chat-call --path=0:1 exits 0 and reports MODEL_CLEAR while property is null and no replay evidence exists.
findings.impact: A syntactically valid replay request can be silently ignored while the command still claims the T2 status, weakening fail-closed evidence handling.
findings.requiredResolution: Reject --path unless the selected suite executes property replay, and report ASSURANCE_MODEL_REPLAY_SUITE_INVALID with a nonzero exit.

findings.evidence: This isolated automated review lane ran focused tests only and did not start, monitor, or poll full CI.
findings.requiredResolution: The coordinator must own one complete Phase 1 CI execution at the unchanged frozen implementation head after all open P1 findings are resolved and exact-head reviews are rerun.
